results.history_match_candidate: Retrofit Karar Masası — Modernize Et mi Değiştir mi?
results.decision_reason: Same legacy-machine retrofit decision/readiness workflow already exists in idea history; quality acceptance evidence is an extension, not a distinct enough core job.

MHRA confirms stronger lifecycle/post-market oversight for AI medical devices, but multiple purpose-built medical-device PMS/QMS platforms already cover monitoring, complaints, CAPA, risk and audit evidence; exceeds <=3 ceiling.

Turkey-specific Hamle Program eligibility/evidence/submission workflow is narrow and regulation-driven; targeted review found portals/consultancy rather than a dedicated applicant-side evidence workspace.

Restricted-component/BOM provenance and regulatory compliance is already a mature product category; robotics/local-AI framing does not make the core workflow distinct enough and direct/near-direct competitors exceed <=3.

Incident-to-control mapping, remediation ownership, closure evidence and audit packs are established SIEM/SOAR/GRC workflows; AI-assisted attack labeling is not a sufficiently distinct product wedge and competition exceeds <=3.
